title: SOUTH KOREA IS OVER
summary: A Kurzgesagt animation on South Korea's record-low fertility rate and rapidly aging population. It explains why a demographic collapse looks hard to reverse and projects the population shrinking sharply by 2060.
why: Go-to link for the consequences of collapsing birth rates, showing why South Korea's decline looks unfixable.

quote.text: This is a nice explanation from Kurzgesagt showing precisely why South Korea is completely screwed long term
